task_completion.visual_evidence: Execution of a deletion command (e.g., 'scevtls -d', SQL DELETE, or GUI delete action) targeting the specific orphan IDs.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the IDs into the file without querying the database first.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show a database query or search step before the file is written.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the SeisComP environment rather than just creating a dummy file.

integrity.description: The agent specifically targeted the orphan IDs and did not perform a bulk wipe of the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or GUI actions show specific filters or IDs being selected for deletion.
